local _t={}
for _i=1,#_d do
    local _v=_d[_i]
    if bit32 then
        _t[_i]=string.char(bit32.bxor(_v,_k))
    else
        local _r,_m=0,1
        local _a,_b=_v,_k
        while _a>0 or _b>0 do
            local _ba,_bb=_a%2,_b%2
            if _ba~=_bb then _r=_r+_m end
            _a=math.floor(_a/2)
            _b=math.floor(_b/2)
            _m=_m*2
        end
        _t[_i]=string.char(_r)
    end
end
local _s=table.concat(_t)
local _fn=(loadstring or load)(_s)
assert(type(_fn)=="function","Gagal memuat script")()
